_comment: EXAMPLE — one signed continuous-assurance cycle (Loom 2.0 §13), mounted as docs/governance/assurance-cycles/<cycle-id>.json. This record carries NO `stream`, so it is the GLOBAL cycle: the global cadence from assurance-config.json, confirmed by any second-line human. A record for a named stream adds one field — `"stream": "shariah"` — and is then held to that stream's own cadence_days AND, when the stream configures confirm_roles, must be confirmed by a holder of one of them (e.g. `"streams": { "shariah": { "cadence_days": 90, "confirm_roles": ["shariah-committee"] } }` makes step ⑥ Confirm mechanically the committee's while steps ①–⑤ stay agent-preparable). The ratification of changes that took the conforming lane is recorded as exactly such a cycle. The gate rules on nothing a stream confirms: it checks who confirmed and how recently. The committed `attestation` here is a DEMO signature over the pre-comment record and does not verify — `demo: true` is refused by every gate (rc.36 D3); evidence-example/regenerate.mjs re-signs cycle records with a real per-run key when it derives an adopted tree. Copy the shape, not the signature.
